Usage: web-listening [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                       
                                                                                                                        
 Web Listening - monitor websites for changes                                                                           
                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.                                              │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.       │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ validate-access-contract       Validate and inspect one access contract offline.                                     │
│ validate-acquisition-contract  Validate a producer-confirmed acquisition contract bundle offline.                    │
│ diagnose-site                  Probe robots.txt first and produce bounded sitemap planning evidence.                 │
│ list-site-skills               List valid and invalid filesystem Site Skill candidates.                              │
│ inspect-site-skill             Inspect one exactly selected Site Skill package.                                      │
│ validate-site-skill            Statically validate a package path or one exact registry selection.                   │
│ add-site                       Add a website to monitor.                                                             │
│ list-sites                     List all monitored sites.                                                             │
│ check                          Legacy target checking is disabled; use governed run-scope.                           │
│ list-changes                   Show recorded changes.                                                                │
│ download-docs                  Legacy direct download is disabled; use governed scoped execution.                    │
│ list-docs                      List downloaded documents.                                                            │
│ analyze                        Run AI analysis on recent changes.                                                    │
│ list-acquisition-tools         List acquisition tool contracts and probe capabilities.                               │
│ build-acquisition-profile      Build a default acquisition profile control artifact.                                 │
│ inspect-browseract             Inspect an optional BrowserAct CLI without browser interaction or writes.             │
│ fetch-article-content          Fetch article content and emit its JSON evidence envelope.                            │
│ probe-acquisition              Inspect candidate adapter evidence; direct target reads are disabled.                 │
│ preview-execution-plan         Compile a read-only acquisition execution preview without probing runtimes.           │
│ serve                          Start the FastAPI server.                                                             │
│ discover                       Discover staged workflow site sections and write inventory artifacts.                 │
│ classify                       Classify discovered sections and write classification artifacts.                      │
│ select                         Inspect a reviewed selection artifact and expose the chosen path clearly.             │
│ plan-scope                     Compile a reviewed selection into a monitor scope artifact.                           │
│ bootstrap-scope                Bootstrap a stored monitor scope into the tracking database.                          │
│ run-scope                      Run an initialized monitor scope incrementally.                                       │
│ report-scope                   Export a tracking report for one monitor scope.                                       │
│ aggregate-batch-result         Aggregate terminal site results offline, without opening Storage.                     │
│ export-manifest                Export scope document manifest artifacts.                                             │
│ list-jobs                      List persisted staged-workflow jobs.                                                  │
│ get-job                        Show one persisted staged-workflow job and its artifact contract.                     │
│ create-monitor-task            Create a first-class monitor task artifact for agent/human workflows.                 │
│ export-tracking-report         Export a unified tracking report from a scope run and optional task artifact.         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Run one acquisition adapter and return a ToolResult-compatible dict.

    and flattened safety fields remain accepted for compatibility with existing
    local helper callers.

tools.name: web_listening_run_scope

tool_selection_rules.rationale: Start with the lowest-cost public HTTP capture when useful text and links are server-rendered.
Use a rendered public browser probe when JavaScript is needed to expose content.
Use only with explicit authorization and required profile safety gates.
Optional explicit selection only after isolated runtime inspection and profile authorization.
Reserved for reviewed custom extraction jobs rather than generic crawl probes.
Reserved discovery/feed choice for sitemap-driven URL inventory.
Reserved discovery/feed choice for RSS or Atom source updates.

not_for: pages whose primary content appears only after client-side JavaScript rendering
authenticated or authorization-gated browsing contexts
site-specific bulk extraction jobs

operator_inputs.description: Public http/https URL to probe.
operator_inputs.name: url

operator_inputs.description: Stable site identifier when building an inline acquisition profile; not needed when profile_path is provided.
operator_inputs.name: site_key

operator_inputs.description: Optional reviewed acquisition profile to use instead of inline profile fields.
operator_inputs.name: profile_path

operator_inputs.description: Optional profile allowlist; defaults to the probe URL host.
operator_inputs.name: allowed_domains

output_contract.execution: tool selection does not change bootstrap-scope or run-scope execution in this build

tools.purpose: Fetch public HTML with the built-in HTTP crawler.
recommended_when: ordinary public HTML
low-cost public pages where server-rendered text and links are visible in the response
safety_notes: Use only for public http/https URLs.
Honors the configured user agent and HTTP timeout.

not_for: stealth, authenticated, or authorization-gated browser contexts
bulk structured extraction where a reviewed script is a better fit

operator_inputs.name: site_key

operator_inputs.description: Optional reviewed acquisition profile to use instead of inline profile fields.
operator_inputs.name: profile_path

optional_runtime.install_note: Install with `pip install -e .[browser]` and run `playwright install chromium`.

output_contract.execution: tool selection does not change bootstrap-scope or run-scope execution in this build

tools.purpose: Fetch public pages that need client-side rendering.
recommended_when: dynamic JavaScript-rendered public pages
public pages where the HTTP response is thin but browser-rendered DOM contains useful text or links
safety_notes: A reviewed browser_rendered recipe is required; a URL, fetch mode, profile, or probe alone grants no read authority.
The governed gateway reads the main document and every redirect; the browser receives only those bytes and blocks every other request.
Requires optional browser runtime support to be installed.

not_for: direct page capture in this build
JavaScript rendering or stealth-browser contexts

output_contract.execution: tool selection does not change bootstrap-scope or run-scope execution in this build

recommended_when: sitemap discovery or feed-like URL inventory
sites where XML sitemaps are the clearest source of crawl seeds
safety_notes: List-only in this build; do not execute as a probe adapter.

not_for: direct page capture in this build
JavaScript rendering or stealth-browser contexts

safety_notes: List-only in this build; do not execute as a probe adapter.

not_for: ordinary public HTML
unauthorized targets or contexts without explicit operator approval
fixed staged bootstrap/run crawling
